headline: RFP — Children’s Theater Producer
lead: Open solicitation for an independent producer to own a repeatable ~90–120 minute kids theater block across cPALSs family events — starting Toy Drive 2026 and Elk Grove Lunar New Year 2027.

meta.description: Request for proposals: Children’s Theater producer for Elk Grove Toy Drive 2026 and Elk Grove Lunar New Year 2027. Short Fairytale Town–style sets. Proposals due Oct 17, 2026.

statusLine: Open for proposals · Due Fri Oct 17, 2026 · First show Toy Drive Dec 6, 2026

related.label: Related lot
related.text: Children’s Village (activities / crafts) is a separate RFP. You may bid one or both; awards may split.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: cPALSs seeks an independent Children’s Theater producer to own a repeatable kids stage-show product across our family events — short story sets in a Fairytale Town–style grammar (narrator / activator reads · 2–4 characters enact · roam / linger between sets) — so Program is not reinventing the bill each season.

Primary audience: roughly ages 2–8 (preschool through early elementary), with parents/caregivers in the room. Toddlers under 2 may attend as lap listeners; tweens/teens are out of scope for this product.
This is a ~90–120 minute kids block per contracted event, not ownership of the full venue clock.

sections.title: Events in scope

rows: ~90–120 min early in the day · short sets + one optional repeat for trickle-in families
Feb 13–14, 2027 (to be finalized) · Elk Grove Park
Sat daylight ~90–120 min (meet / collect the protectors)
Same ~90–120 min family theater pocket when that festival returns

bullets: Out of scope: Children’s Village / craft tables (separate RFP) · carnival / inflatables · Toy Drive non-kids stage remainder · EGLNY evening Spirit Break / main-stage culture show.

orderedItems.label: Run-of-show template
orderedItems.text: One reusable ~90–120 min ROS — short sets + roam; not one continuous full-length play; not a multi-hour kids marathon.

orderedItems.label: Talent plan
orderedItems.text: Host/narrator (“activator”) · 2–4 character performers · optional magic set(s) · plus a separate bookshop or library table at the stage edge after the set.

orderedItems.label: Day-of stage management
orderedItems.text: For the kids block only at each contracted event.

orderedItems.label: Quotes
orderedItems.text: A — Toy Drive 2026 only. B — Toy Drive 2026 + EGLNY 2027 (preferred). Optional add — next Great Lantern Festival when dates are announced. State clearly whether talent fees are inside or outside the producer fee.

orderedItems.label: Compliance & references
orderedItems.text: Insurance · W-9 · references (2 outdoor / festival kids-stage days preferred).

sections.title: Product rules
bullets: The story host/narrator is not the book table. After each set, plan a separate retail bookshop or library partner at the stage edge so families can linger and browse — a different person or organization from the host.
Vietnamese / APIDA faces are welcome; the bill is not Vietnamese-only.
IP-safe — no trademarked commercial characters in our story pocket.
Coordinate pocket adjacency with the Village vendor; do not own Village activity tables.
Prefer independent producers / Productions LLCs / freelancers (fair or park employees may refer; moonlighting only if conflict-cleared).

sections.title: Evaluation

rows: Proven outdoor / festival kids-stage producing (not only indoor birthday shows)
Willing to own the multi-event 90–120 min template — not the full Toy Drive clock
Fairytale Town–class grammar (read + enact · short sets)
Price clarity and fit to our working budget envelope
Ability to grow the show to peer kids festivals

paragraphs: Working planning math for the EGLNY kids-show talent stack is on the order of a few thousand dollars; a producer + talent package for two (or three) events may require a cross-program budget. Submit honest quotes — we will reconcile before award.

sections.title: How to respond
paragraphs: Email your proposal to contact@cpalss.com with subject: cPALSs Children’s Theater Producer RFP.
Include: company / producer bio · sample run-of-show · quote options A/B (+ optional GLF) · talent approach · insurance summary · references.
Questions before the proposal deadline: same inbox, same subject line with — question appended.

contact.title: Submit a proposal
contact.intro: Prefer email. Attach PDFs or links; keep proposals readable.
